purpose: Four rows of T3467-official-pop-2000, end to end, before the registered 2,008-call flight: prove the -np 2 serving geometry on this roster, the released system message, the user-turn text part after the audio, sealing and the four registered Audio2Tool scorers on real sealed rows -- including the first tier-7 turn_00 user-turn wav this repository has ever put on the wire and all THREE of the roster's 654-second release-defect rows, which are the flight's worst requests. No smoke number is a task measurement.

T3467-official-pop-2000.selection: deterministic and stated before the rows were read off the roster: the LONGEST sample of each of the four tiers. That covers all four strata and every worst request in the flight -- the three 654-second release-defect rows (tier 3, tier 6 and tier 7) plus tier 4's 5.976875 s maximum.

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean pass. The plan registers 12 because attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run id on every request. 12 covers a clean pass plus up to two recoveries; the exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 1,969.880708 s per pass, 5,909.642124 s across three passes, rounded up to 5,950; the exposure row's ceiling is 6,000. The number is large for a four-row smoke because three of the four rows are the release's 654-second synthesis defect, which is exactly why they are the rows that must be proved before the flight.

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape and its system-message hash (which must be the in-code-default variant, sha256 be7f31a2e8c7e6dd..., 16,143 chars), whether every stratum's audio encodes and returns at all -- most of all the three 654-second rows -- parse rate and throughput
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 2,008-call flight is launched
